messages:
maria (sec-eng): FYI — Big enterprise call with Corvina on Thursday. They want: RBAC mapping details, KMS/HSM options for Private, audit-log retention + proof we ship logs off-host, vuln triage SLA, and IR notification timeline. Can we assemble a short FAQ + one-pager?

josh (platform): I can draft RBAC + SSO wording. Quick Q: do we give tenant-level role examples (admin, operator, observer) or keep it generic? Corvina asked for explicit matrix.

arjun (infra): I'd prefer explicit matrix. Example mapping we use for Private: tenant_admin -> full key ops, deploy, user mgmt; tenant_operator -> deploy, scale only; tenant_auditor -> read-only logs, no key access. Note: service accounts are scoped by project and require scoping flag.

olivia (eng-oncall): For incident/IR timeline they want "Initial acknowledgement" and "Customer notification" windows. We currently ack Sev 1 in 15m and notify customers within 60m for hosted; for Private we need to confirm runbook (usually within 4h for infra-impacting issues if no contractual SLA).

sam (acct): Corvina specifically asked if we support HSM-backed KMS (FIPS / PKCS11) for private. What's the short answer to put in the one-pager?

arjun (infra): Short answer: "Yes — Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM (via KMIP or cloud KMS integrations) for key-encrypting-key (KEK) workflows; we can integrate on-prem HSMs with a gateway or accept cloud-provider HSMs."

maria (sec-eng): Please add caveat: HSM onboarding has a lead time (2–6 weeks depending on network/access and QSA requirements). Also include key rotation and dual-control notes.

josh (platform): Draft RBAC matrix snippet for the FAQ (pasteable):

```
Roles: tenant_admin, tenant_operator, tenant_auditor, svc_readonly
- tenant_admin: manage tenants, deploy models, manage keys (KEK wrap/unwrap), create/delete service accounts
- tenant_operator: deploy & scale workloads, no key unwrap, limited config
- tenant_auditor: read-only access to audit logs, settings view only
- svc_readonly: scoped service account for embeddings/endpoint calls (token-limited)
```

josh (platform): Also include SAML/SCIM mapping note: we support mapping groups to roles and can export role assignment audit trail.

olivia (eng-oncall): Audit logs: we ship structured audit events (JSON) to customer-managed sinks for Private: S3/GCS/HTTP. Default retention on-host is 90 days; for enterprise we can propose 1y export to their archive. We should include sample event fields: actor, action, resource, before/after, request_id, timestamp.

maria (sec-eng): Put this sample audit query snippet in the one-pager for "proveability":

```
-- Example: find key access events for tenant 1234
SELECT timestamp, actor, action, resource, request_id
FROM audit_events
WHERE tenant_id = '1234' AND action LIKE '%kms%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

arjun (infra): Vulnerability triage SLA: propose 72h initial triage for high/critical after discovery (internal or vendor report), remediation plan within 7 days or mitigation. For customer-facing comms we can promise status updates every 24h until resolved for criticals.

sam (acct): Corvina also asked if we perform third-party scans (SCA/DAST). Answer: we run regular SCA and annual external pentests; we can share executive summary and remediation timelines under NDA.

security-bot: Ticket SEC-4823 created to track Corvina deliverables. Assignee: maria.

maria (sec-eng): Plan: josh -> RBAC & SSO paragraph; arjun -> KMS/HSM onboarding & key lifecycle; olivia -> audit logging + IR timeline; sam -> compliance/pentest answers + NDA note. I'll assemble the one-pager and a short 3-slide deck for the call.

josh (platform): I'll put the RBAC matrix in a Google doc and link it. (link: https://docs.redwood.example/rbac-corvina) :thumbsup:

olivia (eng-oncall): Heads-up: if they press for log-chain cryptographic proofing (tamper evidence) we can offer hash chaining on export and provide verification tooling. Add a short note.

maria (sec-eng): Good catch. Add a line about hash-chaining and signed manifests for exported log bundles.

sam (acct): I'll confirm call agenda with Corvina and ask them to enumerate any non-standard compliance questions ahead of time.

maria (sec-eng): Thanks everyone — deadline EOD tomorrow for drafts. Will ping again when I have the assembled doc. :pray:
